teaser: Three invoices sit stapled on the desk after everyone else has clocked out, and you are still checking the totals twice. Life path 8 asks for mastery of the material world — money, authority, the weight of running things. ISTJ holds the line so systems keep working, fact by fact, duty before mood. Cross the two and you get someone who treats responsibility as proof of worth, measuring a good day by what got closed out rather than how it felt.
